=ada: them (clitic pronoun, accusative plural; leans on an earlier word)
pad(i)-: foot (classified by the foot sign PES)
tu(wa)-: put, place (classified by the PONERE sign)
warriyamalla: at ease, in comfort (indeclinable; classified by the BONUS sign; meaning approximate)
asa-: sit, dwell (classified by the seat sign SOLIUM)
hantili-: foremost, first, earlier (built on the FRONS 'front' sign)
=wa=ada: quotative particle + 'them' (=ada, sounded =ara) — fused in one ligature sign
usa-: lead, bring (here) (classified by the foot sign PES)
irhi-: border, frontier (classified by the boundary sign FINES)
=wa=di: quotative particle + =di 'for himself' (3rd singular reflexive dative, sounded =ri) — fused in one ligature sign
harwa-: road, way (classified by the road sign VIA)
i-: go (classified by the walking-feet sign PES₂)
wanatti-: woman, wife (classified by the FEMINA sign)
sitta-: spindle (classified by the spindle sign FUSUS)
-ri: instrumental ending — 'with' (the sign tara/i also carries the stem's last syllable)
(PES₂.PES₂)da-: walk, pass along — written with two walking feet; the Luwian word behind the picture is unknown
-nti: 3rd person plural present ending — '(they) …' (the n goes unwritten)
asiya-: living, dwelling (written with the SOLIUM.MI sign, as 'sit, dwell')
Attanawanni-: Adanawan, of Adana (classified by the city sign URBS)

__broaden__.ammu: I (written with the pointing-figure sign EGO) · me — here the dative, 'before me'
__broaden__.=mu: me (clitic pronoun, leaning on the first word) · for myself — dative, as in 'to/for me'
__broaden__.-nza: accusative ending · dative plural ending; also neuter singular nominative
__broaden__.-di: ablative ending — 'because of' · instrumental ending — 'by which, whereby'
__broaden__.-i: dative ending — 'upon army' · 3rd person singular present ending — '(he/she) …s'; also the dative ending, e.g. 'upon'
__broaden__.-ya: dative ending — 'to, for' · neuter plural ending, nominative or accusative; also dative 'to, for'
__broaden__.-ta: 3rd person past — '(there) were' · 3rd person singular past ending — 'was'; a neuter plural subject takes a singular verb
__broaden__.-nzi: plural ending · common plural ending, accusative or nominative
__broaden__.-nta: 3rd person plural past — '(they) were' (the n goes unwritten) · 3rd person plural past ending — '(they) destroyed'
__broaden__.allummida-: meaning unknown — perhaps 'strongholds' or 'strong places' (one of this text's unique words, under the fist sign) · strong(?) — taken as an adjective agreeing with a plural noun; meaning uncertain
__broaden__.ibami-: the sunset, the west (classified by the setting-sun sign OCCIDENS) · dative case — 'in/at the west'
__broaden__.kistami-: the sunrise, the east (classified by the rising-sun sign ORIENS) · dative case — 'in/at the east'
__broaden__.=pa: but, and on the other hand (contrast clitic) · topic shifter — 'and as for …', 'but'
__broaden__.harnissa-: fortress (classified by the fortress-wall sign CASTRUM) · neuter plural accusative — 'fortresses'
__broaden__.Azzattiwada-: Azatiwada — the ruler who speaks this inscription (his name may mean 'beloved of the Sun') · here sounded Azzattiwara-, d heard as r
